verdict.rationale: The evidence describes changelog posts, segmentation, a customizable widget 'notification trigger', and API/webhooks/integrations. None of this documents user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. Segmentation targets an audience, the widget trigger is a display setting, and webhooks and integrations are developer building blocks rather than a first-party rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
